description: Every LLM provider transport (Anthropic Messages, OpenAI chat completions, Ollama / vLLM / OpenAI-compatible) lives in the one completion module, bin/lib/anthropic.ts: request bodies, provider headers, stop-reason handling, streaming, the session cost cap and the SESSION.log llm record. No other shipped module names a provider API path or provider header; call complete() / probeLlmEndpoint() instead. (Renaming the module renames this row, but it stays one module.)
